content.comment_body: Apologies for my English. Starting with [product_name] [version_no], I'm unable to enter passwords for remote access in the Android App. I get a 'Profiles not available' error... [product_name] [version_no] [article_no]. I would appreciate any solutions.

The app supports both [product_name] [article_no] and [product_name] [article_no]. However, Android versions below 4.1 are not supported.
I'm referring to access control. From what I know, this only works with [article_no] and up. As far as I'm aware, it isn't implemented for [article_no].
Understood. I didn't know that... What steps can be taken to protect [product_name] from unauthorized access?
I checked [product_name] [version_no] since I couldn't find anything similar for access control. I think there's no way to prevent unauthorized access with [article_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered confusion and obstacles regarding access control and password protection for remote access to [product_name] [article_no] devices through the Android app and [product_name] [version_no]. It became clear that password security features are only supported with more recent hardware versions ([article_no] and up), so users cannot effectively secure [article_no] devices from unauthorized access via the app.
